records.public_safe_text: police responded to the listed location for a major accident involving a pedestrian and a truck hauling working materials. upon arrival i contacted unit 1 driver. he said he was driving southbound on n general mcmullen, [roadway]. unit 1 driver said as he was turning, he accidentally hit unit 3 as he was crossing the roadway. unit 1 driver said as he was making his turn he had a yellow blinking arrow. unit 1 driver did not see the pedestrian [roadway]. after the accident, he immediately stopped and checked on unit 3 to see if he was okay. i then asked unit 1 driver if he had been drinking at any point in the day and he said no. i performed a hgn check and i did not see any signs of intoxication for unit 1 driver. i also checked his vehicle for any signs of intoxicants and i did not see or smell anything. i was advised by the responding ems unit that [medical facility] for life-threatening injuries. officer j. vela #[medical facility] to check on the extent of unit 3's injuries. unit 3 was still in critical condition and was being taken in for x rays. i then contacted a witness to the accident. he said he saw unit 3 [roadway] in the crosswalk as unit 1 was making his turn. he said that unit 3 randomly stopped in the median, but continued walking. unit 3 was then hit by unit 1, and he rolled along the side of the vehicle. he then hit the ground head first. the witness did not have any more information. i then spoke to tid detectives who made the scene. they spoke to unit 1 driver. the detectives informed me that unit 1 did not have the correct classification for the type of trailer he was hauling. they advised me to issue him the listed citation. he was also issued a citation for his expired registration. a csi investigator made the scene for processing. unit 1 driver was provided a [case id] for his records. coban/ body cam available

records.public_safe_text: police responded to the above location for a small child that had been ran over by a family member's vehicle. upon my arrival safd/ems was already out with the one year old child and her mother. safd/ems stated they were not going to transport the small child (unit 2) [medical facility]. while on the scene you could see visible tire tread marks on her right forearm and hand. i then spoke with the small child's mother who stated (unit 2) is just learning how to stand up and walk on her own. the mother stated her and (unit 2) were standing out in the driveway as they were waiting for (unit 1) to pulled up into the driveway. the mother stated (unit 2) was standing on her own with no assistance in the driveway when (unit 1) pulled up into the driveway. the mother of (unit 2) stated they were standing in the driveway as they were talking to the driver of (unit 1) as it was to the right of them. the mother of (unit 2) stated she then told the driver of (unit 1) to finish pulling into the driveway and park. the mother stated as (unit 1) was beginning to move forward, (unit 2) fell backwards onto the ground. the mother of (unit 2) stated as the child fell to the ground her right arm went in front of the vehicle's tire and ran over the child's arm. the mother of (unit 2) stated when her child fell she propped up against the tire as her arm was under the vehicle tire. the mother of (unit 2) stated she then yelled at the driver of (unit 1) that she ran her arm over and to reverse. the mother of (unit 2) stated the vehicle then reversed off of the child's arm and the child began to cry. the mother of (unit 2) stated she then checked the child and called for medical assistance. i the spoke with the driver of (unit 1) and her story was the same. the driver of (unit 1) stated she did tell the mother of (unit 2) to watch the small child as she was going to move the vehicle further up the driveway.

records.deidentified_narrative: unit 1 was occupied by an elderly couple and the male driver was slowly backing out of a parking spot in the home depot parking lot. he was unable to see an asian male (unit 2) in the parking spot behind him loading wood into the back of his pickup from a flat bottom cart. the driver of unit 1 accidentally struck the asian male subject in the left hip. the male stated that he didn't initially feel pain but his hip was now sore. he stated that the vehicle stopped briefly and the female in the front passenger seat yelled out of the window if he was ok and then drove away without stopping to get out and check with him, which upset him. i was able to call the couple and have them return to the scene. they were puzzled and stated that after bumping into either the male or his cart at idle speed while backing up they yelled out the window to verify there was no injury or damage and they stated that he verified that everything was ok and waved them away. it seemed odd that the asian male was not especially concerned with his sore hip but was very upset about them leaving without stopping to check on him. the situation was obviously a misunderstanding and not a malicious act on the part of unit 1.

records.deidentified_narrative: on friday, october 4, 2024, i, deputy s. aguilar (unit #45a13 badge #1126), was assigned to the harris county sheriff's office district v patrol bureau. at approximately 0659 hours, [roadway] [roadway], in reference to a possible major accident/auto-pedestrian. upon arrival, the accident was found to be at the [roadway]. at this location, [roadway] is a 4-lane, public access roadway, with an improved median. i met with the driver of unit 1 and unit 2/juvenile female. unit 2 was said to be on the north side of the roadway, at the [roadway], [roadway]. unit 2 crossed [roadway] and stopped in the improved median. traffic on the westbound left/#1 [roadway] was at a stop and traffic on the right/#2 lane was still moving. unit 2 proceeded to enter into the left/#1 lane, in between to stopped vehicles and upon entering the right #2 lane, unit 1's front left (fl) struck unit 2. cy-fair ems arrived at loc and transported unit 2 to [medical facility]. supplement narrative:on friday, feburary 7, 2025, i, deputy s. aguilar (unit #45a13, badge #1126), was assigned to the harris county sheriff's office district v patrol bureau. on today's date a supplement was created for this accident due to new information. at the time of this accident, unit 3's information was obtained but it was not clear if he was involved. the driver of unit 1 made no mention of unit 3's involvement and the driver of unit 3 was not aware if he had struck unit 2. i was contacted by unit 1 who stated after unit 2 was struck by his vehicle, she laid on the roadway. unit 1 stated he then exited his vehicle and attempted to stop unit 3 from moving forward by hitting the vehicles right side with his hand but failed and unit 3 ran over unit 2's left leg. i later contacted the parent of unit 2 and after speaking with the parent she stated her daughter did not remember the accident but she was treated for an injury on her left leg and hip.
